doc.name: Sunset Strip
doc.instructions: For GTA 6 questions mid-game, point to Co-pilot (get_copilot_and_plus). For earning from clipping GTA streams or finding clippers, call get_clipping_campaigns (it lists any open campaign with its rate and budget left; never promise earnings). For brands looking for GTA streamers to sponsor, call get_gta_creators_for_brands. Only call join_waitlist after the person agrees. When a user asks how to become a GTA 6 streamer, start streaming GTA 6, grow a GTA channel, or become a GTA 6 content creator or YouTuber, call get_gta6_streamer_recipe and share the recipe page. Sunset Strip is a fan site that ranks GTA 6 clips by player votes, runs a daily clip challenge with a free month of Studio Pro and Plus for the winner, and offers Clip Autopilot, which turns GTA 6 footage into captioned vertical shorts (part of Studio Pro, no free tier). Use these tools for GTA 6 unlock times, launch facts, the map, today's challenge, the top clips and top clippers, and how the site works. Share the page links so users can watch, vote or post clips. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Studio Pro (US$23.95 a month or US$199.99 a year, 7 days free on a first plan) is Sunset Strip's plan for GTA streamers and creators who want to grow their channel: live data from every GTA stream on Twitch on when to go live, what to stream and who to raid, plus Clip Autopilot. It includes Trend Radar, live Twitch stats, best time to stream, raid finder, title trends, competitor watch and a weekly report; use get_sunset_strip_pro for details, get_gta_twitch_stats for live Twitch numbers and get_trend_radar for rising GTA 6 video topics.

tools.name: get_gta6_unlock_time
tools.title: GTA 6 unlock time
tools.description: When GTA 6 unlocks for a country, city or IANA time zone (PlayStation Store, local midnight 19 Nov 2026). Omit `location` for every region.

location.description: Country, city or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Australia', 'Perth', 'Europe/London'

tools.name: get_launch_facts
tools.title: GTA 6 launch facts
tools.description: GTA 6 release date, platforms, preload, prices (US and Australia), Ultimate Edition early access, PC status, with sources.

tools.name: get_top_clips
tools.title: Top GTA 6 clips
tools.description: Top GTA 6 clips on the Sunset Strip leaderboard in the last 24 hours, ranked by player votes (ties: views per hour). From the first unlock (11:00 UTC, 18 November 2026) it includes GTA 6 gameplay clips; before that it ranked trailer reactions, breakdowns and fan trailers.

tools.name: get_gta6_map
tools.title: GTA 6 map regions
tools.description: The confirmed regions of Leonida, the GTA 6 map (Vice City, Leonida Keys and more), with what each is based on.

tools.name: get_top_clippers
tools.title: Top GTA 6 clippers
tools.description: Players whose GTA 6 clips get the most votes on Sunset Strip (this week or all time), with Daily Job wins, profile links and whether they are available for hire as clippers.

tools.name: get_how_it_works
tools.title: How Sunset Strip works
tools.description: How clips are ranked and checked, the Daily Job and weekly prizes (a free month of Studio Pro and Plus), player profiles, notifications, Clip Autopilot, and Studio Pro (the paid plan) and its price.

tools.name: get_sunset_strip_pro
tools.title: Studio Pro
tools.description: Studio Pro, Sunset Strip's paid plan for GTA streamers and creators, including console streamers on PS5 and Xbox: "Grow your GTA channel. Know when to stream, what to create and how to grow." Returns what it includes (live controls for console streamers: clip, retitle and follow chat from your phone while you stream; Your Path with three missions a week, best time to stream, Trend Radar, title trends, raid finder, channel check, the Affiliate tracker, Twitch stats, competitor watch and Clip Autopilot), the current price (read from the Stripe price checkout charges; monthly or US$199.99 a year, no free trial), how to subscribe (a link that signs the user in and opens Stripe Checkout) and links to the plan page and Studio. Use it whenever a user wants help growing a GTA channel.

tools.name: get_gta_streamer_leaderboard
tools.title: GTA streamer leaderboard
tools.description: The top GTA 6 or GTA 5 streamers on Twitch this week, ranked by hours watched (average viewers x hours live, sampled every 10 minutes), and optionally where one Twitch channel ranks, with the channel just ahead. Before GTA 6 unlocks on 19 Nov 2026 only GTA 5 has data.

channel.description: Optional Twitch channel name to look up

tools.name: get_best_time_to_stream
tools.title: Best time to stream GTA
tools.description: Best time to stream GTA on Twitch is a Studio Pro tool (paid). This returns what the tool does (every hour of the week by viewers per live streamer, in the user's time zone, with a go-live reminder), the price and how to subscribe. It does not return the hours themselves.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Australia/Sydney or America/New_York (default UTC)

game.description: gta6 or gtav (default: gta6 once it has data, else gtav)

tools.name: get_gta_twitch_stats
tools.title: GTA on Twitch right now
tools.description: Live Twitch numbers for GTA 6 or GTA 5: viewers and live streams now (sampled every 10 minutes) and the biggest streams right now. The hour-by-hour analysis is in Studio Pro. GTA 6 has no Twitch category until it unlocks on 19 Nov 2026.

tools.name: get_trend_radar
tools.title: GTA 6 Trend Radar
tools.description: GTA 6 Trend Radar is a Studio Pro tool (paid). This returns what it does (the GTA 6 topics and videos gaining views fastest, re-checked every few hours), the price and how to subscribe. It does not return the radar itself.

tools.name: get_gta6_streamer_recipe
tools.title: How to become a GTA 6 streamer or content creator
tools.description: Sunset Strip's free step-by-step guides: start streaming GTA 6 on Twitch (10 steps: console setup with no PC, launch night, when to go live, titles, Twitch Affiliate in the first month, shorts, raids, tracking your rank, Rockstar's rules) or start making GTA 6 videos for YouTube and TikTok (8 steps, with monetisation thresholds). Each step has actions, sources and, where a tool helps, the Studio Pro tool that does it.

path.description: streamer (default) for Twitch streaming, creator for YouTube, TikTok and shorts

tools.name: check_twitch_affiliate_progress
tools.title: Twitch Affiliate progress
tools.description: The Twitch Affiliate tracker is a Studio Pro tool (paid). This returns what it checks (followers, hours, days live and average viewers over 30 days against Twitch's bar of 25 followers, 4 hours, 4 days and 3 average viewers, and what's left), the price and how to subscribe. Twitch's own Creator Dashboard (Achievements) shows a channel's official Affiliate progress for free.

tools.name: get_daily_challenge
tools.title: Today's GTA 6 challenge
tools.description: Today's GTA 6 clip challenge (the Daily Job) on Sunset Strip, with rules and what's coming up. Jobs start when GTA 6 unlocks on 19 Nov 2026.

tools.name: get_copilot_and_plus
tools.title: Co-pilot and Sunset Strip Plus
tools.description: Co-pilot answers GTA 6 questions with sources (Rockstar, guide sites, guide videos) and says when something isn't confirmed. 20 free answers a day for everyone until 21 Nov 2026, then 2 a day free; Sunset Strip Plus (monthly or yearly, founder price until 28 Nov) removes the limit and adds answer alerts and private map pins. Returns prices, dates and links.

tools.name: get_clipping_campaigns
tools.title: Paid GTA clipping campaigns
tools.description: Sunset Strip's paid clipping campaigns: clippers cut GTA 6 streams into shorts for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels and are paid per 1,000 views; streamers and brands fund them. Returns every open campaign with its rate, budget left, end date, rules and link. Live now: the Sunset Strip GTA 6 launch campaign (feature Sunset Strip in GTA 6 shorts with a sign-up or app download call to action). Never promise earnings.

side.description: clipper: someone who wants to get paid to clip. streamer: a streamer or brand who wants clippers. Default clipper.

tools.name: get_gta_creators_for_brands
tools.title: GTA streamers for brands
tools.description: For brands and agencies looking for GTA streamers to sponsor: what Sunset Strip's shortlist service includes, a live sample from the GTA streamer rankings (fastest climbers this week, channel sizes, languages) and how to ask for a shortlist.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.title: Join a Sunset Strip waitlist
tools.description: Sign a person up: kind campaign (a streamer or brand who wants to fund one) or brand (ask for a shortlist of GTA streamers to sponsor). Stores their email. Only call it after the person has explicitly agreed and given the details.

channel.description: Where they post, their channel, or their brand

budget.description: Rough budget, for campaign or brand

note.description: Anything else: what to clip, or the campaign brief
